Updated review written to [review.json](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/.sdlc/runs/20261103-feature-extend-scaffolder-conditional-fields/review.json) (`verdict: "approved"`, 0 findings).

### Verification of Revise Changes
- **Same-step vs. cross-step hidden fields in `ReviewState`**: [ReviewState.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/ReviewState/ReviewState.tsx#L98-L112) omits only keys present in [`collectCrossStepHiddenKeys`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/lib/schema.ts#L581-L611), preserving the exact pre-change `findSchemaForKey` -> `processSchema` / `[[formatKey(key), value]]` fallback for same-step hidden fields.
- **`findSchemaForKey` parity**: [util.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/ReviewState/util.ts#L36-L84) resolves cross-step conditions via `resolveConditionalSchema(step.mergedSchema, formState as JsonObject, priorStepKeys)` and retains the original `dependencies` data population and `if (!!res)` check for same-step schemas.
- **Test coverage & changeset**: [ReviewState.test.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/ReviewState/ReviewState.test.tsx#L734-L832) verifies both cross-step hidden field omission and same-step hidden field rendering with its formatted key, and [scaffolder-cross-step-conditional-fields.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-FE-08-argon-attempt2/.changeset/scaffolder-cross-step-conditional-fields.md) accurately documents the behavior.
